#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    bool possible = true;
    while (m != 0 && possible) {
        int d = m % w;
        if (d == 0 || d == 1) {
            m /= w;
        } else if (d == w - 1) {
            m = (m + 1) / w;
        } else {
            possible = false;
        }
    }
    cout << (possible ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;
    return 0;
}
